displayName: GPT Image 2 — Pro Pack on RunComfy
description: GPT Image 2 on RunComfy. GPT Image 2 (OpenAI ChatGPT Images 2.0) is the strongest text-rendering image model available — embedded text, logos, signage, multilingual typography, and high-fidelity layout. This skill calls GPT Image 2 through the RunComfy CLI: `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/text-to-image` (or `/edit`). GPT Image 2 has 3 fixed sizes and supports up to 10 reference images on the GPT Image 2 edit endpoint. Triggers on "gpt image 2", "gpt-image-2", "ChatGPT Images 2", "ChatGPT Image 2", "OpenAI Image 2", "GPT Image", or any explicit ask to generate or edit with GPT Image 2.
